_about: Policy index for report writing. This deliberately holds policy NAMES, canonical URLs and a plain-language summary of what each prohibits — not the platforms' full policy text. Their wording is copyrighted, several platforms disallow automated fetching in robots.txt, and the report only needs the correct policy name plus a link a reviewer can check. Cite the name, link the URL, and quote sparingly from the page itself.
_maintenance: Policy names change — Meta renamed 'Hate Speech' to 'Hateful Conduct' while keeping the old URL slug. Re-check anything marked verified:false before relying on it in a formal referral, and update last_verified when you do.

facebook.note: Policy list read directly from Meta's Transparency Center on this date.

policies.name: Dangerous Organizations and Individuals
policies.prohibits: Designated terrorist organisations, hate entities and their leaders; praise, substantive support or representation of them, including logos, flags, slogans and media-affiliate branding.

policies.name: Violence and Incitement
policies.prohibits: Threats of violence, calls to action, statements of intent, aspirational or conditional statements, and instructions for making or using weapons.

policies.name: Hateful Conduct
policies.prohibits: Attacks on people based on protected characteristics — race, ethnicity, national origin, religion, caste, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, serious disease. Includes hateful stereotypes, slurs, and calls for exclusion or segregation. NOTE: Meta renamed this policy from 'Hate Speech' to 'Hateful Conduct'; the URL slug is still hate-speech.

policies.name: Coordinating Harm and Promoting Crime
policies.prohibits: Coordinating or advocating for harm, and publicising crime, including recruitment and coordination for offline harm.

policies.name: Restricted Goods and Services
policies.prohibits: Attempts to buy, sell, trade, donate, gift or solicit non-medical drugs, pharmaceutical drugs, marijuana, firearms and endangered species.

policies.name: Fraud, Scams, and Deceptive Practices
policies.prohibits: Deceiving people out of money or property, including counterfeit goods and deceptive commercial claims.

policies.name: Child Sexual Exploitation, Abuse, and Nudity
policies.prohibits: Content that sexually exploits or endangers children. Reports route to NCMEC; media is never stored or described by this system.

policies.name: Additional Protection of Minors
policies.prohibits: Further protections for minors, including content that risks their safety or exploits them.

policies.name: Suicide, Self-Injury, and Eating Disorders
policies.prohibits: Content that promotes, encourages, coordinates or provides instructions for suicide, self-injury or eating disorders.

policies.name: Inauthentic Behavior
policies.prohibits: Use of Meta assets to mislead about identity, purpose or origin, including coordinated inauthentic behaviour.

policies.name: Account Integrity
policies.prohibits: Fake accounts, misrepresented identity and account-level manipulation.

policies.name: Authentic Identity Representation
policies.prohibits: Misrepresenting who you are on the platform.

policies.name: Violent and Graphic Content
policies.prohibits: Extremely graphic violence, including content that glorifies violence or celebrates suffering.

policies.name: Human Exploitation
policies.prohibits: Human trafficking and other forms of exploitation.

policies.name: Bullying and Harassment
policies.prohibits: Targeted harassment, degrading content and unwanted contact.

policies.name: Adult Sexual Exploitation
policies.prohibits: Non-consensual sexual content and sexual exploitation of adults.

policies.name: Privacy Violations
policies.prohibits: Sharing personally identifiable information without consent, including doxxing.

policies.name: Misinformation
policies.prohibits: Misinformation that contributes to imminent physical harm, interferes with voting, or is a manipulated media harm.

policies.name: Spam
policies.prohibits: Deceptive or misleading practices to drive traffic or engagement.

policies.name: Cybersecurity
policies.prohibits: Attempts to gather sensitive information or compromise accounts.

policies.name: Locally Illegal Content, Products, or Services
policies.prohibits: Content, products or services illegal in a specific jurisdiction.

telegram.note: Telegram's public terms are short. Reporting goes to abuse@telegram.org or the in-app report; ISIS-related channels can be reported to @notoscam / stopCA.

policies.name: Terms of Service — prohibited use
policies.prohibits: Public channels may not be used to post illegal pornographic content or to promote violence on publicly viewable channels and bots.

policies.name: Rule 1 — Violence and hate
policies.prohibits: Communities or content that incite violence or promote hate based on identity or vulnerability.

policies.name: Rule 4 — Minors
policies.prohibits: Sexual or suggestive content involving minors.
